concept: Abyssal Lantern (심연의 등불) — a lantern lineage bearer descends three boundaries: Cinder Span (burning chain bridge, embers, ash), Abyss Chancel (submerged cathedral, mirrors, choir), Echo Throne (empty throne, echoing command). Sound identity: warm lantern light (glass, chime, flame) cutting through cold abyss (stone, sub-bass, choral echo).
promptStyle: dark fantasy game audio, clean mix, no music in SFX one-shots, no voice
